votes.motion: APPROVE Application PLZ-20-2035, “Dazzling Accessories” to be located at 12866 South Maple Springs Road with the following conditions: 1. The site structures and use shall remain in compliance with any and all applicable Riverton City standards and ordinances, specifically the City Home Occupation Ordinance (18.190) and applicable Building and Fire Codes. 2. Applicant must obtain and maintain a Riverton City Business License. 3. Home Occupation must operate within the Fixed Standards and applicable Qualifications and Conditions as outlined in the Home Occupation Ordinance and this approval. 4.
to DENY Application PLZ-20-2035. Commissioner James

to APPROVE Application PLZ-20-2036, “Whitney Short- Term Rental” to be located at 12931 Sandy Slope Circle with the following conditions: 1. The site, structures, and use shall remain in compliance with any and all applicable Riverton City standards and ordinances specifically the City’s Home Occupation Ordinance (18.190.051) and appliable Building and Fire Codes. 2. Applicant must obtain and maintain a Riverton City Business License. 3. Home Occupation must operate according to the Riverton City Code for Short-Term Rentals as outlined in the Home Occupation Ordinance. Commissioner Hansen
to recommend APPROVAL of the Zone Text Change for locating and operating Food Trucks, creating Section 18.230, Mobile Food Vendors, as shown on the attached documents. Commissioner Russell

recommend APPROVAL of the Zone Text Change for Accessory Buildings, amending Sections 18,225.030 and 18.225.040, as sown on the attached documents with the added verbiage that a private lane be excluded from the lot square footage. Commissioner Lefgren
